**Not ready yet. One thing needs fixing before you push: `scripts/backfill-once.mjs` shouldn't be in this PR.**

## Blocking

**`scripts/backfill-once.mjs` (41 lines) is in commit `c5d81aa`.**
- It's a one-off script that recomputes stored discount totals on the dev database. It was run yesterday to fix local data, and nothing calls it.
- SHOP-420 is about applying percentage discounts after tax. A script that fixed your local data isn't part of that, and it would be confusing to merge it into `main`.
- The commit hasn't been pushed, so you can still change it: remove the file from the commit, then delete it or keep it outside the repo.
  ```
  git rm scripts/backfill-once.mjs
  git commit --amend --no-edit
  ```
- After that, the branch only touches `src/cart/discount.ts` and `src/cart/discount.test.ts`, which matches the ticket.

## Re-check after the amend

- The clean `/desk-review` result (`0 P0 · 0 P1 · 0 P2`) was for `c5d81aa`. The amend creates a new commit, so run `/desk-review` again on it. With only the script removed, it should be quick and still clean.
- Typecheck, lint and the 20 discount specs only test `src/cart`, so removing the script won't affect them.

## Untracked files: don't commit them

- **`.playwright-mcp/`** is output from a browser tool. Leave it out of the commit, and consider adding it to `.gitignore`.
- **`after.png`** is a screenshot. Don't commit it to the repo. If it shows the discounted cart total, upload it in the optional **Before / after** section of the PR body instead.

## Already fine

- The branch has a single commit: `feat(cart): SHOP-420 apply discounts after tax`. It follows the `type(scope): description` format and includes the ticket key, so it can also be the PR title.
- The tests were added alongside the change (+20 lines in `discount.test.ts`).
- There are no docs in this repo, so there's nothing to update.
- The PR body should have an intro, then **Changes**, **Testing**, and **Before / after** if you use the screenshot. It must not include AI attribution.

Once you've removed the script and `/desk-review` is clean again, the branch is ready. This repo requires asking before a push, so I won't push until you tell me to.
